description: See which parts of your system a thread's work touches, on a live diagram that redraws after every turn. Each part carries a tag: new, changed, impacted, or removed. Progress from the thread's plan bar fills the parts that each step builds, and flows play hop by hop to show what moves between parts. A second copy of the map opens as a browser page for another screen. A hidden mapper thread keeps the map current, so each update uses tokens on your provider; requires bb 0.48 or later.
